observations: Pink metal gas cylinder with a top carrying handle and brass valve.
Body shows surface rust, dirt, and wear consistent with used condition.
Text 'DIVINE' and 'SUCCESS' visible on the cylinder body in photo 0 and photo 2.
Handwritten marking resembling '3kg' visible on the side in photo 2.
Cylinder sits on tiled floor; shoes in photo 1 give rough scale.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI FERANMI ADEYEMI' appears across all photos.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a worn cylinder; photo 2 shows handwritten '3kg' marking

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty or contain an unknown amount of gas
risks.proof: photo or video of the cylinder on a weighing scale, or connected to a burner

risks.risk: Valve may leak or fail to open and close
risks.proof: video of valve operation with soapy water leak test at the outlet

risks.risk: Cylinder may be internally corroded or lack a valid hydrostatic test date
risks.proof: close-up photo of stamped capacity and test date on the collar or body

proof_requests: Weighing scale photo or video to confirm gas content
Video of valve opening/closing with leak test
Close-up of stamped capacity and test date markings
response.reason: The item is clearly a used 3kg gas cylinder, so it can be priced at its worst case (empty, unverified valve, no integrity proof) while proof is requested to raise the value.
